name: search_accounts
description: Search Wholesale CRM B2B accounts by company name, contact email or phone, with optional filters for assigned sales rep and order status. Returns each account's id, assigned rep, last order date, days since last order, status and lifetime order count.

query.description: Words to match against company name, contact email or phone. Leave empty to list accounts by filter only.

rep.description: Sales rep name or email. Use "me" for the current user's own accounts, or "unassigned" for accounts with no rep.

status.description: active = ordered in the last 30 days, at_risk = 31-89 days, dormant = 90+ days, never_ordered = no orders.

name: get_account
description: CRM summary for one wholesale account: assigned rep and assignment date, last order date, days since last order, typical days between orders, lifetime orders, location, number of contacts, sample box status and the three most recent CRM notes.

name: get_account_notes
description: CRM note history for one wholesale account, newest first, with date and author.

name: get_account_contacts
description: Contacts for one wholesale account: name, title, email, phone and whether they are the main contact, plus the account's business phone.

name: accounts_needing_follow_up
description: Wholesale accounts that need attention: dormant (90+ days since last order), at_risk (31-89 days), sample_follow_up (sample box sent, not yet received, ordered by follow-up date) or new_partner (1-3 lifetime orders). Can be limited to one rep.

kind.description: Which follow-up list to return (default dormant).

rep.description: Sales rep name or email, or "me" for the current user.

name: list_open_tasks
description: Open follow-up tasks for wholesale accounts, derived from sample boxes sent and not yet received, dormant accounts and at-risk accounts. Returns each task's account, kind, due date and summary, with optional filters for one rep and one kind.

kind.description: Which task list to return. Leave empty for all kinds, soonest due first.

rep.description: Sales rep name or email, or "me" for the current user.

name: get_last_contact
description: Most recent CRM note for one wholesale account: date, author, note text and days since, with the last order date for context. Returns no contact when the account has no notes.

name: account_buying_intel
description: Buying history for one wholesale account: year-to-date revenue and orders compared with the same dates last year, percent change, orders placed outside wholesale checkout, and top products by orders with units and revenue.

name: prepare_account_update
description: Prepare a change to a wholesale account for the user to confirm: add a CRM note, mark a sample box sent or received, or assign the account to the current user. Does not save anything. Returns a link that opens the account in Wholesale CRM with the change filled in; the user clicks Save there.

action.description: add_note = CRM note or call log; sample_sent / sample_received = sample box status; assign_to_me = make the current user the account's rep.

note.description: Note text for add_note (required), or what was in the sample box for sample_sent. Write it the way a rep would, in plain sentences.

followUpDate.description: Optional follow-up date for sample_sent, YYYY-MM-DD.

name: wholesale_summary
description: Wholesale (B2B) totals for a date range, like the Wholesale CRM Analytics page: revenue, orders, average order value, number of accounts that ordered, the same dates last year with percent change, and the top product. Defaults to year to date.

startDate.description: First day, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to January 1 of this year.

endDate.description: Last day (inclusive), YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

name: revenue_trend
description: Wholesale revenue and order counts over time for a date range, grouped by day, week (Monday start) or month. Defaults to year to date by month.

startDate.description: First day, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to January 1 of this year.

endDate.description: Last day (inclusive), YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

name: top_accounts
description: Wholesale accounts ranked by revenue or by number of orders in a date range, with orders and average order value. Defaults to year to date by revenue.

startDate.description: First day, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to January 1 of this year.

endDate.description: Last day (inclusive), YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

name: top_products
description: Best-selling products to wholesale accounts in a date range, ranked by revenue, with units sold and average unit price. Defaults to year to date.

startDate.description: First day, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to January 1 of this year.

endDate.description: Last day (inclusive), YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.
